title: •Supreme Chancellor Palpatine
caption: •Stay Here, Where It’s Safe (V)
heading: •Supreme Chancellor Palpatine (V)
game_text_lines:
*Agendas:* ambition, order. While on Coruscant,
Ambush is a Used Interrupt and, each time you
initiate a Force drain with a clone, may draw top
card from Reserve Deck. During your turn, may
make an additional regular move. Valorum is lost.
base_lore: Having enforced a momentous change upon the Senate, the headstrong Queen then wished to return to Naboo and do the same.

notes: Group: Rescue The Chancellor. COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (755×1101) that turns a USED INTERRUPT into a CHARACTER: silver Light character frame (red paint at the right edge); ROUND silver Republic crest → 'Republic' (printed: red Interrupt disc); title '•Supreme Chancellor Palpatine'; destiny 0 (printed 4). LORE PRINTED ON THE SLIP: 'Leader.' (plain; VB5 reissue prints it bold) → replaces the printed lore (base_lore). Right of the lore box: Coruscant ring (pink, as printed) and EPISODE I disc → ring_icons ['episode1']. Art blank. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 4 / POLITICS 5, deploy 4 / forfeit 6 (new); no column icons; VS16 sphere. 'Agendas:' bold incl. colon. Slip text matches the stub. Base lore matches the wiki. Base scan 350 px; Coruscant 2001 line by rule (not legible). Modern: VB5-L-supremechancellorpalpatine-pre.gif (350).
